summary: Upexi, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 reporting that on September 9, 2026 it entered a Loan Borrower Request with BitGo Prime, LLC under its existing Master Loan Agreement, amending terms on roughly $57.3 million of borrowings. The interest rate fell from 11.5% to 7.5% per annum, required collateral dropped to 200%, with margin call at 150%, margin recall at 300%, and liquidation at 115%. Collateral may be locked Solana, liquid SOL, USDC, and US dollars. No special-situations transaction is implicated; this is a routine credit-facility amendment.
